name: YouKnowWhat_1
short_caption: The robot places its hands on its hips in a confident posture before returning to a neutral stance.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and symmetrically lifts both arms, bending its elbows outward and curling its fingers to place its hands firmly on its hips. It holds this hands-on-hips pose for about two seconds, maintaining a level head and stable torso. Finally, it smoothly lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: The robot's elbows flare out wide to the sides, requiring clear lateral space around the torso to avoid striking obstacles or visitors.
